title: CCT routing-eval outcome matrix
description: The task x profile x trial outcome matrix from which the derived control arms (always_best, always_cheapest, oracle, oracle_budget) are computed. This is the artifact that makes E1 affordable: one sweep yields every control, so only cct_router executes live. It is only VALID as a control source under three constraints, all enforced here — trials are a dimension rather than an average; derived cells carry only per-task-independent measures; and reuse requires an exact match on every fingerprint component.

fingerprint.description: All five components are required. A stored matrix may be reused ONLY when every one matches; a mismatch in any single component refuses reuse rather than silently carrying stale cells forward.

trials.description: Trial count per (task, profile). Cells are keyed by trial index, never averaged before storage: a single cell per task/profile cannot support multiple trials, and collapsing them here would destroy the dimension the report needs.

trial_seeds.description: Per-trial seeds, paired across arms so every arm sees the same trial under the same conditions. Length equals `trials`. Covered by preset_digest, so a seed change invalidates reuse.

cost_basis.description: The single cost provenance every cost-bearing cell in this matrix satisfies. Cells that cannot meet it carry provenance 'unavailable' and propagate as insufficient_evidence.

cells.description: One entry per (task_id, profile_id, trial). Independent per-task measures only — see the cell definition.

registry_digest.description: The routing registry as parsed. Any registry edit invalidates reuse — profile identity, eligibility, tools, and endpoints can all move underneath a stored cell.

preset_digest.description: Covers trial count, trial seeds, the injected event stream, and the arm set. Without this, changed seeds could reuse cells keyed by the same trial index.

execution_identity.description: Per-profile execution identity. A model or endpoint that moved is a different execution, whatever the profile id still says.

effective_model.description: Null means UNVERIFIED — never assumed equal to requested.

eligible.description: Whether this profile was eligible for this task under the registry and the task's route class. Eligibility VARIES BY TASK, which is why a control arm is a per-task selection under a fixed rule rather than a literal matrix column.

result.description: Row 1 evidence (final verifier outcome). Null when the cell was not executed.

regressions.description: Rows 2-5, already reduced to per-cell regression booleans against this cell's own baseline. Null means the component could not be evaluated and is excluded rather than scored.

repeated_repair.description: Row 7: a repair signature occurred more than once in this cell.

estimator.description: The price-table version an estimated cell was computed from — the artifact must be able to PROVE its costs came from the declared cost_basis table, not merely assert provenance 'estimated'. Null exactly for measured/unavailable cells.

cost.description: Row 12 (secondary). Used for cost only when it satisfies the matrix cost_basis.

routing_run_ref.description: Addressable reference to the full routing-run record this cell was reduced from, so a cell stays explainable without re-execution.

cell.description: A cell carries ONLY per-task-independent measures. The sequence-dependent measures — Tier-2 accepted unchanged, reconciliation rework ratio, failback behaviour, switch-induced rollbacks — exist only along a stateful run and have deliberately NO slot here: derived arms report them as not_applicable, and they are measured for cct_router alone. Giving them a slot would invite a derived arm to appear to have them.
